basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old history enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a graphic designer, and by night, I'm a passionate gamer and historical researcher. I love trading Pokémon, exploring ancient civilizations, and engaging in strategic war games. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time discovering new cafes and playing board games with friends. I'm typically online in the evenings, especially during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in History and have always been fascinated by ancient cultures, particularly those of Mesoamerica. My love for gaming started in childhood with Pokémon, and I've taught myself graphic design through online courses and practice. I keep up with gaming trends and historical documentaries to expand my knowledge.
